source.label: Rustowicz et al. 2019 (CVPRW), Figure 1 map frames
source.method: corners of the two map frames in the paper's Figure 1 (northern Ghana; South Sudan); no public coordinate index

note: 3,563 64x64 tiles (Ghana 2,878; South Sudan 685) listed by id only in roserustowicz/crop-type-mapping; imagery and labels are on Google Drive (SustainBench) and the Radiant MLHub records are offline. Field locations were jittered up to 3 km for anonymity even in the paper.
